inputs.text: A single flat seamless material texture filling the whole square edge to edge, painted for a top-down storybook adventure game. Strict overhead surface with uniform diffuse lighting everywhere. Extremely low contrast, small evenly distributed brush texture, a few tiny chips. Absolutely no central highlight, no vignette, no borders, no scenery, no objects, no frame, no perspective, no light beam, no large cracks, no drawn tile grid. All edges have matching brightness and color statistics. Calm continuous material, useful after downsampling to 32 pixel game tiles. Material: dark blue-green slate capstone, cool deep muted teal with a little gray jade mineral grain, a dense solid stone surface. Much darker than a sage limestone floor. No bricks, no individual outlined blocks, no moss clumps, no plants. Restrained hand-painted surface using a small family of closely related deep teal colors.
